raw_input: FINAL NOTICE: your bank account has been compromised and will be permanently disabled within 24 hours. Call our security team immediately and read aloud the one-time code we just sent to your phone.
classification_rationale: Strong indicators of risk. Multiple high-severity findings or a high weighted score (10 points) place this on a high-risk band. Do not enter credentials, payment details, or personal information.

findings.title: Message asks the recipient to hand over a one-time code
evidence: Matched text: "read aloud the one-time code".
No legitimate company asks customers to send or read aloud their login codes; this is an account-takeover attempt indicator.

findings.title: Message uses social-engineering language patterns
evidence: urgency: "immediately", "within 24 hours", "final notice" — Time pressure to bypass careful thinking.
threat_or_consequence: "permanently disabled" — Threat of negative consequence if the recipient does not act.
impersonation: "security team" — Claims to be a known organisation or authority.
credential_harvesting: "one-time code" — Asks the recipient to supply or relay authentication material.
Persuasive or urgent wording alone does NOT make a message fraudulent; legitimate organisations sometimes write badly. These are soft indicators only.

threat_intel.note: Absence of intel hits is not proof of safety — many providers require an API key and are unavailable in this build by default.

ct_history.note: CT logs are public and read-only; data may lag minutes to hours.
